narrative.northStar: A lived-in teenager's study and retreat
narrative.overview: The teenage study and retreat now occupies the actual LearningHouse, preserving Digi-World’s soft low-poly style. teen_bedroom.tscn instances learning_house_detailed.tscn and nearby_neighborhood.tscn. The same detailed house appears in window_transition_preview.tscn, a neighborhood copy with its old house/interior replaced. The existing neighborhood_filled.tscn also uses this shared house at ExistingNeighborhood/LearningHouse. Its old bedroom furnishings and extra fill light were removed; other neighborhood nodes, other authored scenes and startup settings remain unchanged.
dos: Do preserve shared house geometry, neighborhood lighting and source exterior placements.
Do keep the window corridor clear and lesson anchors static.
donts: Don’t treat camera animation as lesson functionality.
Don’t promise pixel-identical lighting or certified continuous performance.
